name: Zoku Oku-sama wa Onee-chan!?
original_name: 続・奥様はおねえちゃん！？
source: Toshiya and Yukari have been a married couple for a year but are not experiencing peaceful days as the wife, Yukari, is passionately studying new sexual techniques to spice up their love life. Meanwhile, they have the added complication of Yukari's sister-in-law, Kaori, moving in and behaving very freely, trying to initiate sexual activity. In addition, a new classmate of the husband, Tomomi, is showing a keen interest in him. Other characters, such as Yukari's mother Masae and classmates, also provide comedic moments and advices. Will they be able to maintain their happiness amidst these challenges?
translation: Toshiya和Yukari结婚一年了，但日子并不平静，因为妻子Yukari正在热情地学习新的性技巧，为他们的爱情生活增添情趣。与此同时，Yukari的嫂子Kaori搬进来，行为非常自由，试图发起性活动，这给他们带来了额外的麻烦。此外，丈夫的新同学友美也对他产生了浓厚的兴趣。其他角色，例如由香里的母亲正惠和同学，也提供了喜剧时刻和建议。他们能否在这些挑战中保持幸福呢？
